# Prompt Log – General

Work that is not part of one project: the repository, its rules, the design system, the landing page and the tools.
Each project has its own log (NN: `NN/docs/PROMPT_LOG.md`). Prompt numbers are shared by all logs; a prompt that did
work in several places has an entry in each log, and its API calls are split by the files they touched.
Token numbers are **measured** with `tools/token_usage.py`, which reads the Claude Code session log. Cross-check with `/cost`.

<!-- COSTS:START -->

**By prompt**

| # | Prompt | API calls | Output | Cache read | Cost |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 12 | There are a few things I want to have changed. … | 8 | 3,042 | 1,674,052 | $0.49 |
| 13 | There are three things that need to be changed … | 45 | 46,309 | 15,076,264 | $4.84 |
| 14 | now it looks quite good but there is one last t… | 17 | 23,194 | 7,261,837 | $2.21 |

Category rules: **Planning** = plan mode or questions/plan approval · **Training & testing** = training, verify scripts, pytest, API checks · **Documentation** = Markdown files and this log · **Implementation** = other file edits and shell commands · **Research & context** = reading files, PDF, skills · **Answers** = replies without a tool call.

Prices (USD per 1M tokens, Claude Opus 5.5): input $4 · output $20 · cache read $0.20 · cache write $5 (5 min) / $8 (1 h). `/cost` also counts small side calls (e.g. session titles, ~$0.002) that are not in the session log. The prompt that is running while the table is generated is only partly included. Last updated 2026-10-19 22:11.

## #12 – 2026-10-19 – "Restructure for a git repo with NN as the first project, make the page work on GitHub"
- **Repository layout:** `INSY/` root with `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md` (rules for all projects), `index.html` (landing page),
  `.gitignore`, `.github/workflows/pages.yml`; projects as folders (`NN/`). CLAUDE.md split into root (repo conventions)
  and `NN/CLAUDE.md` (project).
- **GitHub Actions** `pages.yml`: Python 3.14 + emsdk → build → tests → deploys the landing page to `/` and each project to `/<project>/`.
- **GitHub:** public repo <https://github.com/FreitagWieDerWochenTag/INSY> created and pushed (`gh repo create`), Pages enabled
  with source GitHub Actions; first workflow run green (build 1m0s incl. all tests, deploy 9s). Links in the READMEs changed to
  the real account name.
- Installed with Homebrew: `emscripten`, `gh`.
- `tools/token_usage.py`: `MERGE_INTO_PREVIOUS` lists short follow-up prompts (GitHub login back-and-forth) whose API calls
  count toward the prompt before them. Totals unchanged. Test added.
- **Tokens:** see the "By prompt" table (only the calls of the general part)

## #13 – 2026-10-19 – "Apple-like design with the Lufthansa colors" (+ Safari fix and Log tab in NN)
- Questions: palette = current Lufthansa style (navy + white base, yellow only as accent for active things), a `DESIGN.md`
  for all projects, and the Claude Design tool.
- **Design tokens:** navy `#05164d` + white, yellow `#ffad00` only for active states, system fonts (San Francisco), big tight
  headlines, frosted sticky nav, pill controls, borderless cards (radius 18, soft shadow). Chart colors s1/s2/s3 checked with
  the dataviz validator in both themes; all text pairs ≥ 4.5:1 (computed).
- **Claude Design:** "INSY Design System" artifact (Design System type): tokens (21 colors × light/dark, type scale, spacing,
  radii, shadow), brand book, 10 components with live previews and a cover.
- **`DESIGN.md`** at the repo root with the same rules and a copy-paste token block; root CLAUDE.md points to it. Landing page restyled.
- `tools/token_usage.py --write-log` also writes `token_usage.json` (for the Log pages); prompts without API calls are dropped;
  answers to clarifying questions count toward their task.
- **Tokens:** see the "By prompt" table (only the calls of the general part)

## #14 – 2026-10-19 – "Start page with general things and projects; one prompt log per project plus a general one"
- **Landing page** (`web/` in the repo root, deployed to `/INSY/`): section **General** (Design, Prompt log) and section
  **Projects** (NN). The NN prompt log is only linked inside NN.
- New pages: `web/design.html` (DESIGN.md rendered, with live color swatches from the tokens) and `web/log.html`
  (this log with its token charts). `web/build.sh` copies DESIGN.md and this log into `web/build/`.
- **One log per project + a general log:** this file (`docs/PROMPT_LOG.md`) is new; the general parts of #12 and #13 moved here
  from the NN log. `tools/token_usage.py` moved from `NN/tools/` to the repo root and writes every log (`LOGS`): a call
  goes to NN or General by the paths its tools touched (`project_of_call`), otherwise by the prompt's default
  (`PROMPT_PROJECT`). Prompt numbers stay global; the totals over all logs equal the session total.
- CLAUDE.md (root and NN) updated: which log an entry goes to, the new script path.
- **Tokens:** see the "By prompt" table (the running prompt is only partly counted there)
